resolved_findings.issue: Monitoring credentials could reach legacy authentication-only mutation routes.
resolved_findings.resolution: Central strict method/path allowlist is enforced before returning the paper_monitor principal, including mixed monitor/admin roles; explicit scope rejection cannot fall back to an API key. Actual position-close route tests assert no broker construction.

resolved_findings.issue: Direct JWT WebSocket and Socket.IO authentication bypassed the central monitoring scope.
resolved_findings.resolution: All three external decode_token handlers reject paper_monitor before subscription/session/scanner work; actual-handler negative tests cover them.

resolved_findings.issue: Watchdog restart shortened the API's required shutdown grace.
resolved_findings.resolution: Known-container restart allows 60 seconds for shutdown and a 90-second command timeout; startup grace and persisted 15-minute cooldown remain bounded.

resolved_findings.issue: A login backup could reserve a day-only archive and suppress the later post-close snapshot.
resolved_findings.resolution: Each successful run publishes an immutable UTC timestamped snapshot; a regression covers distinct morning and post-close state.

resolved_findings.issue: Research reconciliation could declare success despite a different entry cost basis.
resolved_findings.resolution: Unrounded Decimal entry VWAP is compared with an inclusive $0.00005/share tolerance, mismatches block RECONCILED, and output exposes price/notional differences.

resolved_findings.issue: An intervening log-read failure could discard an undelivered critical alert count.
resolved_findings.resolution: Pending event counts are retained before all early returns; the failed delivery, failed read, retry sequence is tested.

resolved_findings.issue: The new PR workflow could terminate the full pack before its internal timeout budget and leave no upload headroom.
resolved_findings.resolution: Full-pack timeout is 25 minutes and enclosing job timeout is 50 minutes.

resolved_findings.issue: Hosted workflows rejected runner.temp expressions in job-level environment before any job started.
resolved_findings.resolution: Three workflows write identical isolated paths to GITHUB_ENV from RUNNER_TEMP after checkout and before tests. Focused CI validates all four changed workflows with pinned, SHA-256-verified actionlint 1.7.12; behavioral regression executes each path-export script and verifies ordering.

resolved_findings.issue: Nightly used a synchronous PostgreSQL URI for async tests and silently skipped migrations by checking the wrong path.
resolved_findings.resolution: Use locked asyncpg for tests and run Alembic through the existing backend/migrations environment, which converts the migration URL to psycopg2. Regression verifies configured migration path and fail-closed invocation.

resolved_findings.issue: Benign startup prose about critical tables and zero critical failures generated operational critical alerts.
resolved_findings.resolution: Retain ALERT markers, explicit uppercase CRITICAL text and structured critical severity; ignore observed informational prose and zero-failure phrase. Thirteen added regression cases verify matching and no spurious notification; pending retry logic is preserved.

resolved_findings.issue: Runtime snapshot assigned an unsupported unsaved-activity cause to differing historical counters.
resolved_findings.resolution: The diagnostic acknowledges potentially different accounting scopes/save times and requires ledger attribution before changing counters; no counter is changed.

resolved_findings.issue: Hosted suites could exhaust the former process limits despite successful replay taking 283.47 seconds, and scheduled jobs differed from readiness test environment.
resolved_findings.resolution: Align safe placeholder secrets, import path and all four scratch state/telemetry paths; raise ordinary/semantic process caps to 180s and replay to 600s while preserving per-test limits and failure semantics. Full consumers reserve 40-minute pack steps and 70/110-minute jobs, with contracts checking accumulated limits and reporting headroom.

resolved_findings.issue: Backup failure/freshness evidence previously remained logs-only rather than reaching the local monitoring alert path.
resolved_findings.resolution: Opt-in read-only checks now report missing, invalid, corrupted or >26h latest brain/PostgreSQL publications through the existing deduplicated/retried notifier. Latest invalid evidence cannot be hidden by older backups; bounded receipt/inventory/hash checks never invoke recovery. Documentation correctly states the shared 10s/512MiB per-invocation budget and distinguishes archive freshness from engine-state freshness.
